candidates.name: BIT
candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: OmarchyPet desktop companion concept exploration, round 01. Create ONE square polished concept presentation for ONE character, not a comparison of different characters. Solid flat charcoal background #282828. Palette: off-white #E4E4E4, near-black #161616, restrained ice blue #ADD8F0. Design must read at 48–64 px with strong unique silhouette, restrained desktop-friendly personality, imaginative and memorable. Large full-body hero centered occupying 55% of canvas, generous negative space. At bottom place three small additional poses of this SAME character (idle, attentive, success) each about 8% canvas width; no surrounding UI, no frames, no landscape, no chat boxes. Minimal small monospaced heading top-left, exact heading as specified. No other text, no watermarks. This is an independent original Omarchy-inspired design, monochrome foundation, computer-art heritage; don't reproduce a trademark.
Heading "01 / BIT". Character: a squat wide pixel-art gecko, horizontal low-to-ground quadruped with a comically large angular head, two small square eyes, stubby four feet and a thick staircase-curved tail sticking upward at one end. Curious alert posture. Entire drawing constructed as authentic crisp low resolution sprite art on a strict pixel grid, hard square stair-step edges, 5 flat colors, no smooth vector outlines, no gradient, no 3D. Strong silhouette with visible negative gaps under belly. Pale icy gray body, charcoal face patches, single blue stripe along tail. Not a cat, not a robot, no accessories. Desktop game sprite feeling, tiny competent mischievous creature, not infant toy.
